fields.name: work memory
fields.meaning: Live game state kept in battery memory (map, unit, pilot and item tables, names). The save slots are copies of parts of it; it is not a save by itself
fields.evidence: diffs across played states without saving (changes while playing, no save made); writers d000:a36e/a5e8 copy 2279/2eb5/3235/3983/3cb6/4036/1cc9 from here; slot copies equal these tables byte for byte

fields.name: signature
fields.meaning: Save-area signature, value 007B. If this or its copy at 7D84 is wrong, or the area checksum fails, the game rewrites all slots to empty at power-on
fields.evidence: code d000:adfe (power-on check and rebuild), read at power-on by d000:ae1c; value 007B in all 112 saves

fields.name: area checksum
fields.meaning: Checksum of the whole save area 404E-7D7D: 16-bit sum of little-endian words, carry dropped. Copy at 7D86
fields.evidence: code d000:af68 (AX>=3) and c000:27a2 (AX>=4); recomputed equal on all 112 saves

fields.name: battle save: money
fields.meaning: Money (funds) at the time of the battle-map save, cap 9999999
fields.evidence: code d000:a5e8 <- RAM 0244 (slot table d000:a2fc); shown by d000:b1b4; added by f000:87cb; value 0 and screen shows 0

fields.name: battle save: counter
fields.meaning: Second 32-bit counter, cleared with money at new game; 0 here
fields.evidence: code d000:a5e8 <- RAM 0968; reset d000:94a2/9cee

fields.name: battle save: battle values
fields.meaning: Two 16-bit battle values, restored on Continue
fields.evidence: code d000:a36e <- RAM 096c/096e; d000:a8ca loads back

fields.name: battle save: battle value
fields.meaning: Battle value restored on Continue
fields.evidence: code d000:a36e <- RAM 0248; d000:a8ca

fields.name: battle save: battle mode flags
fields.meaning: Battle mode bits; the loader sets bit 0400 when resuming
fields.evidence: code d000:a36e <- RAM 024a; d000:a8ca loads it OR 0400; value 1000

fields.name: battle save: battle value
fields.meaning: Battle value restored on Continue
fields.evidence: code d000:a36e <- RAM 0242; d000:a8ca

fields.name: battle save: battle work block
fields.meaning: 32-byte battle work block (phase/map state); byte 4074 = 3 here
fields.evidence: code d000:a36e <- RAM 08da-08f9; d000:a8ca

fields.name: battle save: cursor row
fields.meaning: Map cursor row (Y) when saved
fields.evidence: code d000:a36e <- RAM 02fc (set from unit +12 by 5000:7834); diff 0E -> 13 after moving the cursor down

fields.name: battle save: cursor column
fields.meaning: Map cursor column (X) when saved
fields.evidence: code d000:a36e <- RAM 02fb (set from unit +11 by 5000:7834); diff 0E -> 0D

fields.name: battle save: battle values
fields.meaning: Six 16-bit battle values restored on Continue

fields.name: battle save: total turns
fields.meaning: Total turns; the screen shows this value plus 1
fields.evidence: code d000:a5e8 <- RAM 0240; d000:b0ce prints value+1; value 0 shown as turn 1

fields.name: battle save: story progress
fields.meaning: Story progress: first byte is the scene index, the word at +2 counts cleared maps (bit flags); read to show the scene/stage on the save list; all zero on the first map
fields.evidence: code d000:a5e8 <- RAM 08fa-0919; decoded by d000:b026 (ROM table d000:a35c + bit count)

fields.name: battle save: owner name
fields.meaning: Owner name copied from the console owner profile (codes A=0B to Z=24), zero-padded
fields.evidence: code d000:9cee via d000:9f4c (console memory read) -> RAM 0938; bytes = WONDERSWAN = console memory 0x60-0x69

fields.name: battle save: owner birth year
fields.meaning: Owner birth year from the console profile, converted from BCD (0 when not set)
fields.evidence: code d000:9cee <- console profile; RAM 0948

fields.name: battle save: owner birth month
fields.meaning: Owner birth month from the console profile
fields.evidence: code d000:9cee; RAM 094a

fields.name: battle save: owner birth day
fields.meaning: Owner birth day from the console profile
fields.evidence: code d000:9cee; RAM 094b

fields.name: battle save: owner sex
fields.meaning: Owner sex from the console profile
fields.evidence: code d000:9cee; RAM 094c

fields.name: battle save: owner blood type
fields.meaning: Owner blood type from the console profile
fields.evidence: code d000:9cee; RAM 094d

fields.name: battle save: units on the map
fields.meaning: 54 records of 58 bytes, one per unit on the battle map: +0 side (00 player, 09 enemy), +1 flags (80 present, 30 set after the unit has moved), +6 unit type, +9 index, +A pilot, +C moves left this turn, +11 column, +12 row, +13 HP, +15 EN, +17 max HP, +19 max EN (u16le); unused records are zero/type FF
fields.evidence: code d000:a36e copies 54x58 from battery work memory 2279 (f000:5136: 2279+i*3A), d000:a8ca restores; coords read as map X/Y by 5000:7834 and c000:1085; diff (moved unit 12: +1 80->B0, +C 1->0, +11 0F->0D); stats cleared as a group by d000:8694; HP==max, EN==max while undamaged

fields.name: battle save: pilots on the map
fields.meaning: 64 records of 14 bytes for the pilots on the battle map (+2 pilot id, +4 u16 value, +8 spirit-points-like value, +B second copy of it cleared after acting)
fields.evidence: code d000:a36e copies 64x14 from work memory 2eb5 (f000:51b0: 2eb5+i*0E); diff record 15 +B 50->00 after its unit acted

fields.name: battle save: unit table
fields.meaning: 110 unit (robot) records of 17 bytes: +0 flags (bit0 in your army), +1 index, +2 unit type, +A assigned pilot (FF none), +B..+F parts (FF none), +10 story-group mask
fields.evidence: code d000:a5e8 copies 110x17 from work memory 3235 (f000:517c: 3235+i*11); column values here (8 in army, group 01)

fields.name: battle save: pilot table
fields.meaning: 91 pilot records of 9 bytes: +0 flag, +1 unit ridden (u16le, FFFF none), +3 pilot id, +4 points (u16le), +8 availability flag
fields.evidence: code d000:a5e8 copies 91x9 from work memory 3983 (f000:51dc: 3983+i*9); values here

fields.name: battle save: word table
fields.meaning: 448 16-bit values (probably upgrade or growth data)
fields.evidence: code d000:a5e8 copies from work memory 3cb6 (f000:51f4: 3cb6+i*2); meaning not traced

fields.name: battle save: item stock
fields.meaning: 20 small counters (probably part stock); all zero here
fields.evidence: code d000:a5e8 copies from work memory 4036 (f000:520a: 4036+i)

fields.name: battle save: names
fields.meaning: Text strings in the game's own character codes, FF-terminated (the protagonist and other entered names)
fields.evidence: code d000:a5e8 copies from work memory 1cc9; written during new-game setup (diff at protagonist setup)

fields.name: battle save: story group flags
fields.meaning: Story-route / party-group flags (1 at new game)
fields.evidence: code d000:a5e8 <- RAM 095d; set to 1 by d000:94a2; matches unit +10 mask 01

fields.name: battle save: marker
fields.meaning: Battle save in use: 007B = valid, FFFF = empty. The title menu only offers Continue when this is valid and the checksum matches
fields.evidence: code d000:af08, title menu Continue path e000:f0ac; diff FFFF -> 007B on save

fields.name: battle save: checksum
fields.meaning: Battle save checksum: 16-bit sum of little-endian words over 404E-5F1D (the last 2 data bytes are not covered)
fields.evidence: code d000:af68 (AX=0); recomputed on both battle saves, equal to stored
